4. Do a failing-first run (current existing failure is acceptable evidence), then run the targeted lifecycle test and the workspaceStore test file.
5. Do not use desktop automation, commit/stage/reset, or edit unrelated code.

Success: the lifecycle test reflects the durable one-tab invariant and full suite failure is addressed by a stronger behavioral assertion.
